author: resepignev
body:
Avicus Community Slack




Preface

The Avicus Community Slack is open for all users of the Avicus Network. To get added to the Slack fill out this form [Here] or ask a Community Slack Administrator.

Each channel has a different level of moderation. Low moderated means the channel is very lenient, medium moderated means that the channels are regularly moderated and highly moderated means that the moderator will be very strict.

We are using a strike system. This means if you have 3 strikes you get kicked out.
A strike will be removed if it was given on an older date and the staff feels it has been a long enough time.


Slack Administrators

If you need help or want to report a user that broke the rules please contact one of the following admins:
  • @piez
  • @resepignev
  • @arigenn
  • @peachy
We are there to help you, so don’t hesitate to contact us.


General Rules

  • No links to pornography, phishing sites, keyloggers, scams, etc. (3 Strikes)
  • No harassing other users, no matter what chat. (1 - 3 Strikes | Depends on the severity)
  • No rumors or drama. We’re trying to get away from that. (1 Strike)
  • Try to maintain a calm and civilized atmosphere in all situations. (1 Strike)
  • No DDoS- or death threats. (3 Strikes)
  • A leaving thread will get you kicked out of the slack. Unless stated that you do not wish to leave.

Commands

Commands start with and exclamation mark (!). You can use them to alert certain groups.

The following commands are available:
  • !slackadmins | Alerts the community slack admins that were mentioned above
  • !devs / !developers | Alerts the developers
  • !seniors / !seniormoderators | Alerts the Senior Moderators
  • !mods / !moderators | Alerts the Moderators
  • !mapdevs / !mapdevelopers | Alerts the Map developers
  • !leaders (teamtag) / !teamleaders (teamtag) | Alerts the Teamleaders of a certain team
  • !coinflip | Let’s you throw a coin (can be head or tails)

Channels

#announcements

  • Do not post in this channel unless otherwise told by an administrator. If you want to discuss what is said in #announcements, please talk in #general about it.
  • Highly Moderated

#feedback

  • If you have any feedback regarding the server, teamspeak, forums, slack, etc. you can post and discuss it in this channel.
  • Highly Moderated

#games

  • In this channel you can talk about all games, minecraft included.
  • Medium Moderated

#general

  • This channel is for various somewhat serious discussions or conversations.
  • Medium Moderated

#map-making

  • This channel is for anything related to map making and maps.
  • The mapdevs try to interact as much as possible with the community.
  • Medium Moderated

#music

  • This channel is for sharing and listening to other’s music and posting your own.
  • Don’t post music that is harmful to other ears or disturbing.
  • Medium Moderated

#random

  • A place for non-work-related flimflam, faffing, hodge-podge or jibber-jabber you'd prefer to keep out of more focused work-related channels. (by slack)
  • Low Moderated

#requests

  • Post things that you wish to be changed/edited.
  • Medium Moderated

#support

  • Post questions in this channel to be answered by an administrator or staff member.
  • Highly Moderated

premium-lounge

  • This channel is for donators only.
  • Medium Moderated

Postface

The Rules are subject to change. It’s your own responsibility to stay updated with the rules. If a rule changes it has an one week grace period to introduce it to the community. This means the staff may warn and do not punish for it. Exceptions can be made.

If you have suggestions, improvements or critic, post in #request and an administrator will take them into account.

The whole document can be found here: https://goo.gl/BCOfYD


Registration

To get added to the Slack fill out this form [Here] or ask a Community Slack Administrator.
Your information like your email address will be kept secret. Under no circumstance will it be publicy accessible.

We (the slack admins) will check the form daily.
